title: Warm Spicy Jamaican Vegetable Salad
description: A cultured and energizing Jamaican dish featuring a vinaigrette dressing, this salad is perfect for a light lunch or snack, and is jain-friendly. It combines the warmth of Jamaican spices with the freshness of vegetables.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toss the mixed vegetables with 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of black pepper, and spread on a baking sheet to roast for 20 minutes.
In a mortar and pestle, pound the scotch bonnet pepper and 1/2 teaspoon of salt until well combined.
Add the chopped red onion, chopped cilantro, lime juice, olive oil, and jamaican jerk seasoning to the mortar and pestle, and mix until well combined.
In a large bowl, combine the roasted vegetables and the dressing from the mortar and pestle, and toss to coat.
Season with additional salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the salad warm, garnished with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
Let the salad cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
